_doc: The offline fault bed's result (jury round 5, the Wybe juror and the data juror: give the done check negatives). Run on branch hamad/faults at 4571de3 (agent/faultbed.py, output in temp/faults/ of that checkout); figures as reported by the controller on Sun 8 Nov, 05:40. Offline only: no Wybe server. The fault wordings are written by the team, so the misses show the kind of reply that fools the check, not how often it happens.
